attrs.note: datasheet - style, material, colour, environment and the included accessories are the specification table of the FS Horizontal Single Sided Manager datasheet (USCMH-SFDABSB1U, USCMH-SFDABSB2U); RoHS and ISO 9001 are its Standards Compliance list.

capacity.note: estimated - FS states no cable capacity for USCMH-SFDABSB2U in any document held, so the 186 is worked out, not read. METHOD: the channel's inside cross-section, the `duct` guide height by the depth from the front face of the base to the rear face of the cover on the side view of the FS Horizontal Single Sided Manager datasheet, divided by 47.7 mm2 a Cat6 cable. 47.7 is the median of the mm2 a cable that FS's own Cat6 counts imply for CMH-SFD1U, CMH-DFD1U, CMH-SFD2U, CMH-BS-SFDS1U, CMH-BS-DFDABS2U, CMH-HD-SFDABS3U and 4U and CMH-UHD-SFDABS1U, 2U and 3U (38.7 to 82.8), rounded up to 0.1; the count is rounded down. CROSS-SECTION: 65.33 x 136.5 = 8917.5 mm2, and 8917.5 / 47.7 = 186.9. The count is of Cat6 24AWG and is marked as an estimate (`cable-capacity-estimated`).

chassis.note: drawing - THE DUCT IS THE RACK WIDTH. The specification table gives 2U as 88.8 x 482.6 x 169.0 mm (3.49 x 19.00 x 6.65 in); the top view draws the duct 482.59 wide over its whole depth and the front view 88.81 high and the same width, so its front is the part itself and not a rack face with ears on (`ears: behind`). The depth is the side view's toleranced 168.5; the table's 169.0 and the top view's 169.9 (Ref) are recorded in `gaps`.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". FS publishes no image of the part; it is drawn in the USCMH-SFDABSB1U's shades, the cover a little lighter than the duct.

depth.note: drawing - along the side view at 3.436 px/mm: the cover over the first 17.5 mm, the finger walls on to 138.0, the base rails behind them to 162.7, and the mounting plate at the rear, 74.33 high, from about 165.5 to the 168.5; the plate is taken as 3 thick. Between the rails the channel runs back to the plate. The top and bottom views draw the rails and plate as one 30.5 mm band, as the top view shows them.

ears.note: drawing - THE EAR FLANGE IS BEHIND THE DUCT, NOT AT ITS ENDS. The 1U part's front view draws ear folds 23.1 mm in from each end and holes 464.47 apart; the 2U part's draws neither - the duct runs the full 482.59 - and its top view draws a plate across the whole width at the very rear, where the screws stand, with the base rails in front of it. The side view draws that plate 74.33 high behind the 84.33 finger walls. It is a different moulding, not the 1U part made taller: it bolts to the face of the rails through the ends of that plate and stands entirely in front of them, so `ears: behind`. `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder: Portrayal's reading of the side view puts the whole duct and its mounting plate in front of the rails (see `full-depth`), so `at` is 168.5, the whole depth. `behind: true` is the same statement the bare string made. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

fingers.note: drawing - the top view at 5.309 px/mm: seven straight fingers on a 48.5 mm pitch, the middle one on the middle of the duct, each two ribs 8.3 wide with a 9 mm slot between them, 25.4 across over the straight run and flaring to 28.4 at the rail, which is not drawn; and two flat walls at each end, from the end of the duct to 19.2 and from 40.5 to 60.1, drawn as one 19.4-wide part at 0 and 40.6. The gaps come out even, 23.1 between every pair. They are straight, where the 1U part's fingers have T-shaped tips. The hooked cable retainers the top view draws near the cover are not drawn. The top view shows one row; the bottom row is taken as the same, as the side view's two equal walls draw it.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, over the whole face: its shoulders a band 11.5 high at top and bottom and a hinge clip in each corner, read off the front view. The finger rows stand 2.24 to 11.74 and 77.07 to 86.57 down the face, the side view's 84.33 finger walls centred on the 88.81 and 9.5 thick. The `duct` guide is the channel between them over the full width.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the whole duct, mounting plate included, is the 168.5 of the side view in front of the rails, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger walls, run across the rack; the pitch and the gap are the top view's 48.5 and 23.1.

left.note: drawing - the side view along the depth: the mounting plate at the rear, the ends of the two base rails, the two finger walls and the cover's edges over their tips. The duct is open at both ends, between the rails as well, and nothing is built across it. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Horizontal Single Sided Manager datasheet (USCMH-SFDABSB1U and -B2U) has a specification table and, for the 2U part, a top view, a front view and a side view in millimetres on its third page, lettered CMH-SFDABSB2U. They are vector art, not embedded images, so the page was rendered at 600 dpi. The top view is 5.309 px/mm across its 482.59 and 5.41 down its 169.9 (Ref), a 2 per cent difference; the front view 5.379 across and 5.46 down its 88.81; the side view 3.436 along its 168.5 and 5.24 up its 84.33 and 74.33, which agree with each other - the side view is not to scale vertically, as on the 1U part. So widths come from the top and front views across, depths from the side view along, and heights from the dimensions and the side view's own vertical scale, never from one view's scale applied to another's axis. The part is portal-only: FS publishes no product page and no image of it, so there is no second reading.

rear.note: drawing - the mounting plate, 74.33 high and centred, across the full width, with the backs of the two base rails above and below it to the 84.33; built as plates sunk 0.05 inside the rear face. No window or pass-through is drawn in any view, and none is declared.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT, NOT A BOX, built as the USCMH-SFDABSB1U is: the base on the front view as a well 138.0 deep whose floor is the fronts of the two base rails behind the finger rows, the fingers standing in it, the cover in it across their tips, which lifts off and opens the channel, and the rails and mounting plate behind the well closed by plates sunk just inside the rear, top, bottom and side faces. The channel, the slots between the fingers and the two ends are open air.

thickness.note: drawing - 9.5, the finger walls' thickness across the height of the duct in the side view at its own 5.24 px/mm (50 px); no FS document states a wall gauge.

top.note: drawing - the top view, rear at y=0: the mounting plate and base rails 30.5 deep, the fingers over the channel to the back of the cover, and the cover over the last 17.5. The bottom is the top again.
